filtered_backprojection_like — TOMOGRAPHY reconstruct op

• 데이터 종류: sinogram × image2d → image2d

• 호출: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.filtered_backprojection_like(sinogram, reference, angles_deg=None, filter_name='ramp', cutoff=1.0, span_deg=None, device='cpu')(구현을 직접 호출하려면 import tomography; tomography.filtered_backprojection_like(sinogram, reference, angles_deg=None, filter_name='ramp', cutoff=1.0, span_deg=None, device='cpu'), 원장에서 가져오려면 opstomography.get("filtered_backprojection_like"))

• GPU: 없음(CPU 참조 구현만)

사용법

참조 영상의 정사각 격자에서 FBP를 재구성합니다。

> 아래 상세 설명은 원문입니다 —— 요약과 제목은 번역되어 있습니다.

This is the explicit companion to filtered_backprojection, whose established default remains the detector-derived inscribed square. The sinogram does not contain the source side length, so it cannot recover that choice on its own. Pass the image that was given to radon_transform::

image = np.zeros((32, 32), np.float64)

sinogram = radon_transform(image)

reconstruction = filtered_backprojection_like(sinogram, image)

assert reconstruction.shape == image.shape

reference is a finite 2-D square image and supplies only the output grid; its pixel values are deliberately not read. A rectangular reference is refused rather than silently returning a square whose shape does not match:

2-D FBP currently reconstructs a square grid. This function cannot prove that *reference* was the image that produced *sinogram*; keep that pairing in the calling pipeline. All filter, angle, span, device and invalid-sinogram contracts are those of filtered_backprojection.

참고(샘플 데이터·문헌)

• 샘플 데이터 카탈로그(DL URL / 라이선스) —— 2-D 는 skimage.data(BSD/public)+ 합성, 3-D 는 실데이터 소스(Stanford/PDS 등)의 DL URL.

• 연산자의 내력·참고문헌 —— 이 연산자 족의 바탕이 된 연구/기법의 출처.

• 알고리즘의 정전(저자·연도)과 용도는 위의 패밀리 사용 가이드에 적혀 있습니다.

실행 가능한 예제(이 연산자를 실제로 호출하는 검증된 샘플)

• ct_reconstruction — py -3.11 examples/ct_reconstruction.py

타입이 이어지는 다음 연산자(image2d 를 입력으로 받는 것)

radon_transform
